messages:
nora: anyone else seeing the latency chart for /v2/respond in sa-east1 go weird? p95 dips below p50 for a 7min span (2026-03-22 ~03:10UTC). screenshot: https://redwood.internal/dash/weird789 :eyes:
ben: that's a red flag. usually means mixed derivation or an interpolation artifact. can you paste the panel queries?
nora: panel has 4 series: p50 from 'smoothed-tdigest' (we added smoothing), p95 raw tdigest, p99 from old rollup_quantiles, and a sample_count series. queries: 
```
# p50 (smoothed tdigest)
SELECT smooth(quantile(0.5, tdigest)) FROM metrics WHERE endpoint='/v2/respond' AND region='sa-east1' GROUP BY time(1m)
# p95 (tdigest)
SELECT quantile(0.95)(lat_ms) FROM tdigest('tq') WHERE endpoint='/v2/respond' AND region='sa-east1' GROUP BY time(1m)
# p99 (rollup quantiles)
SELECT quantile(0.99)(lat_ms) FROM rollup_quantiles WHERE endpoint='/v2/respond' AND region='sa-east1' GROUP BY time(1m)
```
clare: ah there it is 12. smoothing is shifting the median estimate downward between sparse samples and the rollup_quantiles reconstruct p99 differently. when sample_count drops, smoothing can invert ordering temporarily.
metrics-bot: note: sample_count for that window dropped to 3-6 requests/min. low-N warning emitted.
ben: for immediate fix switch p50 to raw tdigest median (no smoothing) so all quantiles use same derivation method. also hide rollup_quantiles temporarily until infra normalizes derivation.
nora: patch applied to change p50 -> raw tdigest median. dashboard deploy by nora started at 03:35UTC.
ui-bot: UI ticket created UI-5024 "percentile smoothing: opt-in and explicit label". proposal: smoothing indicator in legend and a small tooltip explaining effect at low sample counts.
clare: Infra note: rollup_quantiles uses histogram-resynthesis that biases high tails when buckets are coarse. INFRA-3401 created to migrate rollups to tdigest-preserving summaries.
ben: also adding a frontend monotonicity check: if displayed pX > pY for X<Y in same panel and same scope, show a yellow provenance badge and link to diagnostics. I'll open DASH-137.
metrics-bot: diagnostics pinned to panel: shows series derivation: [smoothed-tdigest, tdigest, rollup_quantiles] and sample_counts.
nora: after change, chart monotonic again. leaving smoothing work as opt-in and adding docs in dashboards/percentiles.md about smoothing side-effects and low-sample behavior. closing thread unless INFRA-3401 finds additional variance. thanks all :white_check_mark:
